_comment: Shippable Claude Code settings.json snippet for the supervisor SessionStart health-summary hook. Merge the SessionStart entry into the project's .claude/settings.json alongside the PreToolUse and PostToolUse entries. Unlike those two, this hook is deliberately NOT gated on SHANNON_SUPERVISOR_SCOPE — read-only session orientation must fire in ordinary sessions. It injects a terse Drift-lead health line from the most recent report under the configured report_directory (default docs/supervisor), writes nothing, and always exits 0. Mute it via .claude/supervisor/state.json ("mute_session_start": true).
